display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
At t+2s: all 100 threads are blocked on loaders.
New requests queue in the thread pool backlog.
Queue grows: 500, 1000, 5000 requests waiting.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
At t+4s: first batch of threads returns with errors.
They immediately pick up queued requests ──> blocked again.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
Result: application is unavailable. Every request takes 4+ seconds.
Recovery: circuit breaker opens, new requests fail fast (10ms).
